title: Build cache location
body: Lattice stores its build cache in .lattice/cache and prunes entries older than 14 days.

title: Staging deploy command
body: Deploy to staging with lattice ship --env staging; production needs a second approver.

title: Retry policy
body: Network calls retry three times with exponential backoff starting at 200 ms.

title: Log format
body: Services write JSON lines with the fields ts, level, msg and trace_id.

title: Database migrations
body: Migrations live in db/migrations and run in filename order; never edit an applied migration.

title: Auth token lifetime
body: Access tokens expire after 15 minutes and refresh tokens after 30 days.

title: Code review rule
body: Every pull request needs one approval and green checks before merge.

title: Naming convention
body: Packages use lowercase singular names; test files end with _spec.

title: Flaky test quarantine
body: Tests that fail intermittently go into the quarantine list and are retried twice.

title: CI runner sizing
body: CI runners have 4 CPUs and 8 GB of memory; the integration job uses the large runner.

title: Feature flags
body: New features ship behind flags stored in flags.yaml and default to off.

title: API rate limits
body: The public API allows 100 requests per minute per key and answers 429 beyond that.

title: Translations
body: Strings are extracted to locales/*.po and translators work from the English source.

title: Image resizing
body: Uploaded images are resized to 1600 pixels wide and stored as WebP.

title: Metrics dashboard
body: Latency and error rate dashboards are in the observability workspace; alerts page the on-call engineer.

title: On-call rotation
body: On-call rotates weekly on Monday at 10:00 and the handover note goes in the team channel.

title: Backup schedule
body: Database snapshots run nightly at 02:00 and are kept for 30 days.

title: Pagination
body: List endpoints use cursor pagination with a limit of at most 200 items.

title: Error codes
body: Errors carry a stable code such as E_QUOTA or E_CONFLICT alongside the message.

title: Dependency pinning
body: Dependencies are pinned in the lockfile and updated by a weekly bot pull request.

title: Security headers
body: Responses set HSTS, a strict content security policy and no sniffing.

title: Timezone handling
body: Timestamps are stored in UTC and converted to the user's zone only in the UI.

title: Monorepo
body: We decided to keep all services in one repository to share tooling.

title: Commit messages
body: Commit messages use the imperative mood and stay under 72 characters in the first line.
